query:
UPDATE molecules SET chemical_class = 
  CASE 
    WHEN family IN ('alcool', 'alcohol') THEN 'alcohol'
    WHEN family IN ('phenol', 'phenolique') THEN 'phenol'
    WHEN family IN ('alcaloide', 'alkaloid', 'nicotinoide', 'pyridine') THEN 'heterocyclic'
    WHEN family IN ('acide', 'acid', 'acide_gras', 'fatty_acid') THEN 'aliphatic'
    WHEN family IN ('thiol', 'sulfure', 'sulfide', 'disulfide') THEN 'sulfur_compound'
    WHEN family IN ('precurseur_terpenique', 'terpenoid', 'terpene', 'terpenique') THEN 'terpene'
    WHEN family IN ('monoterpene', 'monoterpenique') THEN 'monoterpene'
    WHEN family IN ('sesquiterpene', 'sesquiterpenique') THEN 'sesquiterpene'
    WHEN family IN ('diterpene', 'diterpenique') THEN 'diterpene'
    WHEN family IN ('cannabinoide', 'cannabinoid') THEN 'phenol'
    WHEN family IN ('lactone', 'macrolide') THEN 'lactone'
    WHEN family IN ('ester', 'acetate') THEN 'ester'
    WHEN family IN ('aldehyde') THEN 'aldehyde'
    WHEN family IN ('cetone', 'ketone') THEN 'ketone'
    WHEN family IN ('ether', 'oxide') THEN 'ether'
    WHEN family IN ('coumarine', 'coumarin') THEN 'coumarin'
    WHEN family IN ('musk', 'musque', 'macrocyclique') THEN 'musk'
    WHEN family IN ('aromatique', 'aromatic', 'benzenique', 'phenylpropanoide') THEN 'aromatic'
    WHEN family IN ('nitrile', 'isonitrile') THEN 'nitrile'
    ELSE 'other'
  END
WHERE chemical_class IS NULL;
